standard_prerequisites: Same chapter: lemma-independence-characters (delivered card L48335), theorem-galois-theory (delivered card L48341, for the fixed-field step), lemma-finite-Galois (|G| = [L : K] = p for a finite Galois extension with group Z/pZ); freshman's dream in characteristic p
core_obligations: For a generator sigma of Gal(L/K) = Z/pZ: sigma^p - 1 = 0 as K-linear operator, and independence of the characters 1, sigma, ..., sigma^{p-1} forbids an annihilating polynomial of degree < p, so the minimal polynomial of sigma is x^p - 1 = (x - 1)^p
Hence (sigma - 1)^{p-1} is nonzero: pick w with y = (sigma - 1)^{p-1}(w) != 0; then sigma(y) = y so y in K (fixed fields), and z = y^{-1} (sigma - 1)^{p-2}(w) satisfies sigma(z) = z + 1
z is not in K (sigma moves it), so [K(z) : K] = p = [L : K] and L = K[z]; sigma(z^p - z) = (z+1)^p - (z+1) = z^p - z, so z^p - z in K
proof_roadmap: Force the minimal polynomial of sigma to be (x - 1)^p
Produce the Artin-Schreier generator by the nilpotent-step construction
Verify the Artin-Schreier equation and generation
